newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Kisen to launch new Atlantic line.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Kisen to launch new Atlantic line.

text.p: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to launch a weekly Atlantic service jointly with China's China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO) and Taiwan's Yangming Marine Transport Corp.
A company official said Kawasaki hoped to begin services after it was granted approval by the relevant authorities in Europe and the United States.
The route will run between the Atlantic east coast in the United States and northern Europe with stops at seven ports including New York and Antwerp.
The new service will be run by four 2,000 TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units) vessels.
Kawasaki, one of Japan's leading ship operators, will provide one of the four ships, with Yangming providing one and COSCO providing two.
